messages:
Priya Kapoor: Quick ask for launch week 1: we need a lightweight visual kit for the benchmark webinar + landing page. Scope: hero banner (web + email), 2 social carousel frames, a single-page schematic of the routing + nurture flow (editable), and a 2-slide benchmark explainer template. Brand sweep mandatory. Target handoff Thu EOD PT. Who's available?

Liam O'Connor: I can handle hero + carousel. Can you confirm the webinar headline and the primary metric to highlight? Also prefer Figma components with auto-layout.

Noah Brooks: Metrics: 90th p95 latency, tokens/sec, and $/1k tokens. Webinar headline proposal: "Make inference predictable: cost, latency, and scale". Landing subhead: "Real-world benchmarks for running LLMs in production".

Zoe Park: For the routing schematic: use the simplified flow: registration form -> qualification step -> SDR triage -> AE handoff -> nurture sequence. Need the Marketo folder + exact UTM string. Use utm_source=launch&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bench_webinar_v1.

Liam O'Connor: Export specs noted:
```
hero_web: 1920x1080 @1x (svg + png 1200px)
email_header: 600x200 png @2x
social_carousel: 1080x1080 @2x jpg + small animated gif (optional)
schematic: svg (editable layers) + png 1600px
slides: figx (figma export) + pdf handout
```
I'll build components and variants.

Em Rivera: Branding: use --redwood-600 for primary CTAs, secondary brand color --redwood-300 for accents. Typography: Inter 600 for headings, Inter 400 for body. Ensure accessible color contrast 4.5:1 for small text. No decorative lens blur on charts; charts should use our alt palette (teal, mauve, slate). I'll run the sweep before final export.

Priya Kapoor: Nice. Also include copy variants for headline A/B: A) "Predictable inference at production scale" B) "Lower per-token cost without giving up latency". We'll test A vs B in paid socials.

Noah Brooks: I'll write two short social captions + a longer paragraph for the landing page. Also adding a 1-paragraph speaker bio for the webinar page.

figma-bot: New file created: <https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/launch-visual-kit|Launch Visual Kit> 1@Liam O'Connor assigned, @Em Rivera reviewer.

Zoe Park: I've attached the Marketo flow doc in the calendar invite. Reminder: form should capture company size and role for routing. If company size >1000 -> assign to AE pool B.

Liam O'Connor: Uploaded first-pass comps to the Figma file (hero + carousel + schematic draft). Leaving comments where I need copy for small labels.

Em Rivera: Running brand sweep now. Flagging two issues: contrast on one carousel variant and icon style mismatch. Will comment in Figma with exact fixes.

Priya Kapoor: Revised timeline: please get drafts by Wed 3pm PT, final assets Thu EOD. We'll need flattened export package (zipped) plus the Figma link. Thanks!

Noah Brooks: Copy drops by Tue EOD. I'll post caption variants here after I finish.

Liam O'Connor: Roger that 1 starting QA passes and prepping export presets. cc @design-ops for handoff checklist.

Zoe Park: Scheduling internal review Thu 10am PT with growth + web ops. Calendar invite sent.

Em Rivera: All comments added to figma. Re-run sweep after fixes.

Priya Kapoor: Great collaboration team 1 let's keep edits to comments in Figma to maintain version history.
